'Constitute Welfare Board, Withdraw Hiked Fitness Fees': Delhi Auto Drivers To Stage Major Protest At Jantar Mantar Today
results.description: Delhi Auto Rickshaw Sangh will stage a protest at Jantar Mantar on Monday, demanding an immediate welfare board for auto-taxi drivers and withdrawal of increased vehicle fitness fees. The union, under Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh, also seeks working-time limits, accountability for transport officials and a ban on bike taxis using private number plates.

results.title: Hong Kong maid cafe operator arrested for allegedly molesting staff, 14
results.description: The operator of a Hong Kong maid cafe has been arrested for allegedly molesting a 14-year-old employee multiple times, beginning on her first day at work. A police source said on Monday that the operator, a 35-year-old man surnamed Cheung, was arrested on Saturday at the cafe in Mong Kok’s Dundas Square.
